notes: 130 accepted / 663 rejected frames; 117 with a usable ground-plane height
units: bone_lengths are MotionBERT root-relative units (NOT meters, see body_calibration.py's docstring); stature_m/measured_stature_m/nose_height_m are meters.
stature_fields: stature_m is measured by the pipeline from the ground plane; measured_stature_m is a tape measurement and WINS when both are present. Set measured_stature_m by hand, or with setup/calibrate_body.py --measured-height.
